description: A cherry red colour, the wine brings the aromas of red berry on the nose. Full-bodied and aromatic, with fine, fruity tannins. wine at 14-15 °C.

name: Georges Duboeuf Pinot Noir (750ml)
description: Full-bodied and hearty, it reveals fresh fruit aromas, such as Morello cherries. Its silky tannins and length make it a very well-balanced wine.

name: Georges Duboeuf Syrah (750ml)
description: The wine is dominated by red and black berry, raspberries, blackcurrants and bilberries aromas which are supported by rich and empowering tannins.

name: Gustave Lorentz Gewurztraminer (750ml)
description: It’s fresh and supple, complex and rich, with an impressive structure. Tastes of exotic fruits and spices with a ginger finish

name: Gustave Lorentz Riesling (750ml)
description: An expressive and refined nose filled with citrus and white flower aromas. It has a lively attack, refreshing acidity, great structure and a clean, dry finish

name: Henschke Keyneton Estate Euphonium 14% (750ml)
description: An intense nose of ripe mulberry, plum, blue and black berry fruits and anise, floral violet notes and hints of cassis, sage and pepper spice. The beautifully balanced palate shows layers of sweet, concentrated fruit and texture, with fine -grained tannins for a long and elegant finish.

name: Jacques Picard Champagne (750ml)
description: Golden pale yellow color, with brilliant shades of silver, this wonderful sparkling is elegant and smooth on the palate, showing strong brioche and creamy notes, supported by apple scents and light fruitiness.

name: Jim Barry Cover Drive Cabernet Sauvignon 14% (750ml)
description: The palate is lively with bright red berries and dark cherry fruit. The wine has an even pull through the palate with fine tannins and a moreish finish.

name: Joseph Drouhin Cote de Nuits-Villages (750ml)
description: Intense aromas of wild cherry, liquorice and mild spices, evolving towards notes of undergrowth and mushroom. On the palate, excellent balance between tannin, acidity and gras (velvety texture).

name: Joseph Drouhin Laforet Chardonnay (750ml)
description: It is a very homogeneous vintage. It is ripe and its aromatic structure is supported by its acidity balance.

name: Joseph Drouhin Pouilly-Fuisse
description: It is ripe and its aromatic structure is supported by its acidity balance. From charming to more intense, deep and complex.

name: Joseph Drouhin Rully White 13% 750ml
description: The aromas are fresh and fruity, with nuances of broom shrub (genêt), almond and delicious preserved citrus notes. On the palate, it is fresh and elegant.

name: Louis Roederer Brut Premier (750ml)
description: In the mouth, the wine has structure, richness and length. It is a full, complex wine that is both modern and powerful

name: M.Chapoutier Belleruche Cote du Rhone Red (750ml)
description: The wine is deep garnet on the appearance, with intense dark fruit aromas on the nose, that is counterbalanced by the white pepper scent and is supported by sooth and velvet tannins.

name: M.Chapoutier Chateauneuf de Pape La Bernardine (750ml)
description: Intense crimson-red. Opening into spicy (liquorice) and fruity aromas.

name: M.Chapoutier Cote Rotie Les Becasses (750ml)
description: Deep purplish red. A touch of black olive and “tapenade”, rose winemary. Ample and deep, woody, spicy and vanilla final.

name: M.Chapoutier Crozes Hermitage Les Meysonniers Org 13% (750ml)
description: Red fruits, blackcurrant and raspberry, followed by violet aromas. Ample and round, final of stewed fruits and vanilla.

name: M.Chapoutier Gigondas Red (750ml)
description: Floral then spicy (pepper) notes on entry. The wine displays a superb tannic structure and lovely long-lingering flavours.

name: M.Chapoutier Chante-Alouette Hermitage Blanc Org 13.5% (750ml)
description: Brilliant and green gold. Frank attack, without aggressiveness, final of almond, very elegant and good length.

name: M.Chapoutier Hermitage Monier de La Sizeranne 13.5% (750ml)
description: Aromas of red fruit (rapberry, blackcurrant), with a hint of liquorice. Good attack, round and elegant wine with concentrated and gentle tannins.

name: Antinori Marchese Chianti Classico Riserva (750ml)
description: The palate is supple and balanced and the toasty and fruity sensations linger on a fragrant and persistent finish.

name: Marques de Caceres Crianza Red (750ml)
description: The wine is perfectly structured and balanced. It is crimson red on the appearance,with deep purple hues. The nose opens with rich and juicy red berries and red fruits, that are complimented by sweet vanilla scent, light leathery notes and a hint of tobacco.

name: Marques de Caceres Crianza Magnum (1.5L)
description: Full-bodied on the palate with a background of ripe fruit and smooth elegant tannins. A long silky aftertaste.

name: Nautilus Sauvignon Blanc (750ml)
description: The palate introduces a delightful lime/citrus based mouth-watering intensity and finishes with a strong textural component.

name: Nicolas Feuillatte Brut Reserve Particuliere 12.5% (750ml)
description: The wonderful and festive champagne is, fresh and vibrant, with intense and expressive aromas of fruits, such as apricots and pears with constant delicate bubbles, gradually unleashing their true character over time.

name: Oxford Landing Cabernet Shiraz (750ml)
description: Subtle notes of blackcurrant and tobaco leaf blend into the dominance of blackberry and plums aromas. Overall palate is an elegant, silky texture of fruit sweetness, while layered the mid-palate with blackberry and spices. Finishing with a note of soft tannins

name: Oxford Landing Chardonnay (750ml)
description: Delicate and elegant taste, which carries a strong aromas of yellow peach, with hints of lemon myrtle and wild honey. While the creaminess is counterbalanced by the presence of the the deeply developed oaky scent

name: Oxford Landing Shiraz (750ml)
description: The wine develops solid and pleasing aromas of fresh plum counterbalanced by subtle vanilla oak with hints of violets and floral aromas. The palate is smooth with blueberry and plum taste, complemented by soft, rounded tannins with hints of milk chocolate and spices.

name: Pascal Jolivet Attitude Pinot Noir 13% (750ml)
description: Deep ruby colored wine expresses delicate flavors of red fruits, cherries and blackcurrants with mild spiciness, with stylish and lasting finish.

name: Pascal Jolivet Attitude Sauvignon Blanc 12.5% (750ml)
description: The minerality gives a long finish to the wine, a smoothness and elegance – characteristics of all of Pascal Jolivet’s wines

name: Pascal Jolivet Pouilly Fume (750ml)
description: On the palate the wine is medium in body, incredibly precise and layered with clean, driving acidity.

name: Pascal Jolivet Sancerre White 12.5% (750ml)
description: The Pascal Jolivet Sancerre is fresh, clean and screaming with racy acidity. On the palate it is fresh and tightly wound; acidity is tempered by very subtle residual sugar; very clean; alive, racy, youthful.

name: Antinori Peppoli Estate Chianti Classico (750ml)
description: The wine imparts all the characteristics of Sangiovese. The tannins are soft and silky, the finish round and persistent.

name: Pigmentum Malbec (750ml)
description: A bouquet of summer flowers as well as powerful red and black fruit aromas: raspberry, blackcurrant, and blackberry
